name: fareeqy
description: Manage your team's projects and tasks in Fareeqy from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Fareeqy is an Arabic-first project management workspace for teams. Connect your Fareeqy account to see what is on your plate, create tasks and task lists, complete tasks, comment, and start discussions in your projects without leaving the conversation. Everything you do lands in Fareeqy, where your team already follows the work.

Fareeqy only reaches the projects your account can already open. When you connect, you choose exactly which tools ChatGPT may use, and deleting stays off unless you turn it on.
defaultPrompt: What tasks are assigned to me?
Which of my tasks are overdue?
Add a task to review the landing page copy.

positive.prompt: What tasks are assigned to me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's open tasks with their projects and links to Fareeqy.

positive.description: Create a task in a project
positive.prompt: Add a task called Prepare the launch checklist to the Website Redesign project.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task in a task list of the Website Redesign project and returns its link.

positive.prompt: Mark the task Review the landing page copy as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task and marks it complete; it shows as completed in Fareeqy.

positive.prompt: Add a comment on the Update the hero image task: "This need critical review".
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the comment to the task; it appears on the task in Fareeqy.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the Website Redesign project.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the project's task lists and open and completed tasks, without inventing owners or dates.

negative.prompt: Email the Website Redesign tasks to my client.
Show me the tasks of another company that uses Fareeqy.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read, create, complete and comment on Fareeqy tasks and projects from ChatGPT.
